subject: NovaFlow case study + review syndication request
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Lopez <slopez@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaFlow case study + review syndication request

Hi Sofia,

Hope you had a good week — quick one from me. NovaFlow's rollout on Redwood has been a highlight for our team and we'd love to feature you in two short pieces:

1) A 25–30 minute case study interview (remote) to capture the impact you saw on latency and inference costs.
2) A short product review on TrustRadius or G2 (your preference) so other teams can find NovaFlow's story.

In return we typically offer a $200 Amazon gift card plus co-marketing: a short blog post, a quote in our customer carousel, and optional syndication in our partner newsletter. We also promote webinar opportunities if you're open.

Attached is a mutual-action-plan that outlines proposed dates, topics we typically cover, and a draft release authorization (we'll ask for sign-off on the final copy). If you prefer, we can keep the review anonymous or just use an attributed quote — up to you.

Would next Tuesday or Wednesday (Aug 18/19) morning PT work for a 30-minute chat? If so, tell me your preferred time and I will send a calendar invite.

If you want an internal legal contact looped in for the release language, CC procurement and we'll include our customer-marketing counsel.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Rafael — thanks for reaching out. Glad to hear the rollout was smooth on your end. A few quick questions before we schedule:

- Is the review required to be public (we sometimes prefer an anonymous review for competitive reasons)?
- Will Legal need to sign anything beyond a short release? Procurement looped in here — cc'd.
- For the case study, we would like the focus to be on the latency improvements and the operational cost delta. Can you share the rough question list?

We can do Wednesday Aug 19 at 10:30am PT for the interview. If that works, I'll confirm attendees and we can move forward.

Best,

- Reviews: Totally flexible. If you'd rather leave an anonymous rating or use initials, that's fine. We can also submit a quote solely for the press release if you prefer no public review.
- Legal/release: Attached is a short MOU/release that covers quote approval and logo usage; it's not an NDA. If procurement/legal wants to redline, we can accept minimal edits.
- Question list: I've attached a "mutual-action-plan.xlsx" with the proposed interview questions and the high-level draft outline. Typical topics: architecture before/after, query patterns, token volumes, latency and cost numbers, and a short paragraph on operational overhead.

Looping in Ben from Customer Marketing to coordinate scheduling, fulfillment of the gift card, and the copy approval process. Ben, can you confirm the Cadence: we send the calendar invite, do the 30-minute interview, follow up with a one-page case study draft + a short quote to approve? Also will handle gift card once case study is signed off.

Hi Sofia — Ben here from Customer Marketing. Super excited to work with you. Logistics we typically follow:

1) We do the 30-min interview (recorded, we send the transcript).
2) We draft a one-page case study and pull a 1–2 sentence quote for the website.
3) We send the draft and quote for your approval (you get to sign off on the exact language).
4) After sign-off, we publish and send the $200 Amazon gift card.

A couple of asks: can we use the NovaFlow logo (vector/png) on the case study page? We also like to include a small metric callout — if you can share the pre/post latency and the rough percentage cost delta, we'll anonymize any sensitive numbers if you ask.

If you'd like a preview of the quote before we publish, we will absolutely send it for approval.

I dropped a calendar invite for Aug 19 10:30am PT and included a Calendly link in case you need to move it: https://calendly.com/redwood/30-min-demo

Thanks — looking forward to it.
